To me, FIRE is simply being mortgage free, because after that expense is gone i can just work a part time job like 2 days per week in order to make enough money for expenses. Thats enough for me to be happy.

Got 29 years left on my mortgage. My wife and I have committed to paying off an extra $2k per month on top of the regular repayments, meaning we'll be mortgage free in 14 years, when we're in our mid 40s. Yeah I'd rather retire at age 35 but that's what you get when you waste your entire 20s doing dumb shit.

If I could give any young person advice: DO NOT "follow your dreams bro" in your 20s. It's literally the most powerful financial/wealth building time you have due to the power of compounding interest and the dumbest thing you could ever do is waste that opportunity. Just get any job, actually do the work, be patient and invest at least 25% of your income. It genuinely doesn't matter that you're not earning $50k per month as an Assmongold streamer or something. If you do this basic strategy you will outpace all of your peers and retire in your 30s/40s
